ladders.note: Strongest internal-consistency check the carbon stack has (§2): a mass cap set to the carbon=25 emissions must price its allowance at ≈ $25; a slack cap prices at 0. Requires a LIVE mass-cap program for the ISO — on an ISO with no covered budget (ERCOT; PJM RGGI is inert per audit D1) the row builds no covered coefficients, no co2_cap_price is returned, and T1.2a SKIPs. A SKIP here is therefore a mass-cap WIRING finding to route to P-1A, not a harness failure (confirmed by the P-0A smoke: the ERCOT cap rungs solve but emit the uncapped tonnage with a null allowance dual).
Discontinuity check: entry economics must shift when the credit cliff moves relative to the build horizon.
